DMCA & Copyright Policy

Last updated: November 10, 2026

Copyright concerns

IPTV4USA respects intellectual-property rights and responds to properly submitted copyright notices in accordance with applicable law.

Submitting a notice

Please include your name and contact details, identification of the copyrighted work, the relevant location or material, a good-faith statement, an accuracy statement made under penalty of perjury, and your physical or electronic signature.

Counter-notices

If you believe material was removed or disabled by mistake or misidentification, you may submit a counter-notice containing the information required by applicable law.

Copyright contact

Send DMCA notices or counter-notices to support@reselleriptv.com.
